name: Library reading room
desc: Study, research, quiet obsession; where a character finds the one page that changes things.
tags: library reading room, tall bookshelves, rows of books, long wooden reading table, green shaded desk lamps, wooden chairs, rolling ladder against the shelves, card catalogue, tall arched windows, parquet floor, balcony gallery above, dust in the air
prose: a library reading room with bookcases climbing the walls, long wooden tables under green-shaded lamps, a rolling ladder set against the shelves and tall arched windows throwing light across the parquet
note: Without the TABLE and the lamps you get a bookshop aisle - the reading furniture is what makes this a reading room rather than stacks. Quiet and scholarly render as nothing; the ladder, the catalogue drawers and dust in the light beams do the work. Book spines dissolve into coloured blocks past mid-ground, so put one shelf near camera if any title has to read.
